(rule! (lambda (g)
         (define bg (mode g -1))
         (define objs
           (sort-by (objects-multicolor g bg)
                    (lambda (obj) (+ (* 1000 (obj-r1 obj)) (obj-c1 obj)))))
         (define comps (map (lambda (i) (list i (nth objs i))) (range 0 (length objs))))
         (define dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
         (define (local-cells obj)
           (map (lambda (p)
                  (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj))))
                (obj-cells obj)))
         (define (port-dir obj lr lc)
           (let ((cells (local-cells obj))
                 (oh (obj-h obj))
                 (ow (obj-w obj)))
             (let ((best (foldl (lambda (d current)
                                  (let* ((dr (first d))
                                         (dc (second d))
                                         (nr (+ lr dr))
                                         (nc (+ lc dc)))
                                    (if (member (list nr nc) cells)
                                        current
                                        (let ((score (+ (if (member (list (- lr dr)
                                                                          (- lc dc))
                                                                    cells)
                                                            10
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and (= dr -1) (= lr 0))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and
                                                              (= dr 1)
                                                              (= lr (- oh 1)))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and (= dc -1) (= lc 0))
                                                            5
                                                            0)
                                                        (if (and
                                                              (= dc 1)
                                                              (= lc (- ow 1)))
                                                            5
                                                            0))))
                                          (if (> score (first current))
                                              (list score dr dc)
                                              current)))))
                                (list -1 0 0)
                                dirs)))
               (list (second best) (third best)))))
         (define markers
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (comp)
                         (let* ((id (first comp))
                                (obj (second comp))
                                (r0 (obj-r1 obj))
                                (c0 (obj-c1 obj)))
                           (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (let* ((lr (- (first cell) r0))
                                         (lc (- (second cell) c0))
                                         (v (at g (first cell) (second cell)))
                                         (d (port-dir obj lr lc)))
                                    (list v id lr lc (first d) (second d))))
                                (filter (lambda (cell)
                                          (not (= (at g (first cell) (second cell)) 1)))
                                        (obj-cells obj)))))
                       comps)))
         (define edges
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (color)
                         (let ((ps (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) color)) markers)))
                           (if (= (length ps) 2)
                               (list (list color (first ps) (second ps)))
                               (list))))
                       (range 1 10))))
         (define (find-place placements id)
           (find-first (lambda (p) (= (first p) id)) placements))
         (define (try-place placements from to)
           (let ((from-place (find-place placements (second from)))
                 (to-place (find-place placements (second to))))
             (if (and from-place (not to-place))
                 (append placements
                         (list (list (second to)
                                     (+ (second from-place)
                                        (third from)
                                        (list-ref from 4)
                                        (- (third to)))
                                     (+ (third from-place)
                                        (fourth from)
                                        (list-ref from 5)
                                        (- (fourth to))))))
                 placements)))
         (define (apply-edge placements edge)
           (let ((a (second edge))
                 (b (third edge)))
             (try-place (try-place placements a b) b a)))
         (define seed-placements
           (if (empty? comps) (list) (list (list (first (first comps)) 0 0))))
         (define placements
           (foldl (lambda (step acc)
                    (foldl (lambda (edge inner) (apply-edge inner edge)) acc edges))
                  seed-placements
                  (range 0 (* 3 (max 1 (length comps))))))
         (define full-placements
           (foldl (lambda (comp acc)
                    (if (find-place acc (first comp))
                        acc
                        (append acc (list (list (first comp) 0 0)))))
                  placements
                  comps))
         (define placed-cells
           (apply append
                  (map (lambda (comp)
                         (let* ((id (first comp))
                                (obj (second comp))
                                (placement (find-place full-placements id))
                                (ro (second placement))
                                (co (third placement))
                                (r0 (obj-r1 obj))
                                (c0 (obj-c1 obj)))
                           (map (lambda (cell)
                                  (list (+ ro (- (first cell) r0))
                                        (+ co (- (second cell) c0))
                                        (at g (first cell) (second cell))))
                                (obj-cells obj))))
                       comps)))
         (define bb
           (bbox-of-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p))) placed-cells)))
         (define r1 (first bb))
         (define c1 (second bb))
         (define r2 (third bb))
         (define c2 (fourth bb))
         (define blank (empty-grid (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)) bg))
         (foldl (lambda (p acc)
                  (set-cell acc (- (first p) r1) (- (second p) c1) (third p)))
                blank
                placed-cells)))
